Method of Attack: Infects Linux devices with implant allowing DNS-over-HTTPS communications with attackers' servers
Uses DNS-over-HTTPS to encrypt communication between infected device and command and control server
Issues encoded TXT DNS requests to C2 servers to exfiltrate data and receive commands
Commands include run, sleep, wget, upload, download, rm, cp, cd
Indicators of Compromise: Use of legitimate DoH servers from Google and Cloudflare
Encoded TXT DNS requests containing AES128 encrypted data
